payload.body: You tend to meet every deadline, accept extra responsibility, and keep the resentment private until one more request produces a flat refusal. The change looks abrupt because other people saw reliability and did not see the cost. This often comes from learning that saying no early would make you irresponsible or difficult. Refuse one extra demand before your only honest answer becomes quitting everything.
